Marta (Support): P1 from trial account acerohealth.dev 15m of failed embeddings, onboarding flows blocked. Error rate ~60%. @Leo can CS take comms?
Leo (CS): On it. Need quick mitigation + ETA. I'll draft a short proactive note and schedule a 15-min bridge.
Marta (Support): Symptoms: /v1/embeddings returning 502s; two tenants also showing 401 token_mismatch. Restarted gateway, flushed caches, tried model failover, still failing. Sample log: `ERROR inference-gateway: upstream 502 for model redwood-embed-5 trace=aa11`
OpsBot: [alert] customer=acerohealth.dev severity=high incidents=INC-3344 affected_tenants=3
Jin (SRE): Likely embed-pool saturation plus a stale token cache. Quick plan: scale standby pool and reissue tokens for affected tenants. Cmds: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-pool-standby --replicas=2` then reissue keys via admin console.
Marta (Support): Tried route to quantized-embed-4; gateway rejects due to model_compat. Will reissue tokens now for tenant-2 and tenant-3. Test curl after reissue: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <new-token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":["ping"]}'`
Leo (CS): Draft comms (short):
"Hi <Name>, we're investigating intermittent embedding failures affecting your trial. We've applied an interim routing fix and are reissuing API keys for affected tenants. Expect stability within 60 minutes. We'll follow up with a postmortem and trial credit. Bridge in 15m if you'd like live updates.  Leo, CS"
Rhea (Acct Exec): Approve goodwill credit/7-day extension given demo schedule. Owners: support/Marta (remediation), SRE/Jin (infra), CS/Leo & Rhea (comms + credits). Reconvene in 30m; escalate to Eng-runtime if not resolved.
